reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for reusable prompt profiles, argument substitution, scoped per-turn model selection, and restoration of the prior agent selection.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可复用的 Markdown 提示配置，支持参数替换、单轮模型选择以及调用后的状态恢复。
summaries.en: Provides reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with argument substitution, per-turn model selection, and restoration of the previous agent state.

capabilities: Discovers reusable Markdown prompt profiles from user and project directories
Substitutes positional arguments into prompt profile bodies
Selects a provider, model, and reasoning effort for a single turn
Restores the previous agent selection after invocation by default
Lists profiles and invokes nested profiles by slash-separated names
